user_input: My mom spent the whole morning telling me about our neighbor’s son who bagged a 25 LPA package, asking when I'll start taking my project seriously. I have a major project evaluation tomorrow and I haven't even written the README file because the thought of debugging makes me physically nauseous. I've been sitting in the dark for three hours just scrolling through reels, not even registering what I'm watching. I'm letting everyone down, but my brain literally refuses to process information anymore—it's like a blown fuse.

sandhi_response: Losing touch with the high achiever you used to be is a deeply painful grief, especially when you are running on empty. You are not broken for needing to pause; your worth as a human remains entirely intact even when you cannot muster the energy to attend class.
